run_protocol_ui_graph: run a labgraph protocol UI graph with a named protocol module and optional fullscreen mode
create_uigraph_config: create a UIGraphConfig with a protocol name and window size for labgraph protocol examples
setup_uigraph_connections: setup a UIGraph connecting ProtocolNode and QtNode topics for current trial, end trial, and ready signals
configure_protocol_node: configure a ProtocolNode with a module path string for running labgraph protocol examples
run_parallel_runner: run a labgraph ParallelRunner with a configured UIGraph to execute protocol and Qt nodes in parallel
